operations.command:
set -ex
u=$(nixosctl eval config.settings.users.admin.username | tr -d '"')
id "$u" >/dev/null
printf %s "$u" > /var/tmp/e2e-update-user
readlink -f /run/current-system > /var/tmp/e2e-update-system-before
readlink /nix/var/nix/profiles/system > /var/tmp/e2e-update-link-before
test "$(readlink -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/system)" = "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-system-before)"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id > /var/tmp/e2e-update-boot
if [ "$(nixosctl eval config.settings.disk.immutability.base | tr -d '"')" = clean ]; then
btrfs subvolume show /.snapshots/@root/CLEAN | grep -E 'UUID:|Creation time:' > /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean
test -s /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean
else
test ! -e /.snapshots/@root/CLEAN
: > /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean
fi
test ! -e /etc/e2e-update
mkdir -p /root/.cache/nix
echo kept > /root/.cache/nix/e2e-update-marker
echo e2e-garbage > /var/tmp/e2e-garbage
nix-store --add /var/tmp/e2e-garbage > /var/tmp/e2e-update-garbage
test -e "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-garbage)"
printf first-generation-recorded

set -ex
host=/etc/nixos/config/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/default.nix
sed -i '/settings.disk.immutability.mode =/a\  environment.etc."e2e-update".text = "second-generation";' "$host"
grep -F 'environment.etc."e2e-update".text = ' "$host"
printf change-written

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-user)
if ! su -l "$u" -c "printf 'n\n' | nixosctl update --clean" > /var/tmp/e2e-update.log 2>&1; then tail -n 80 /var/tmp/e2e-update.log; exit 1; fi
grep -F 'Restart now?' /var/tmp/e2e-update.log
if grep -F 'Invalid input' /var/tmp/e2e-update.log; then exit 1; fi
printf update-succeeded

set -ex
before=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-system-before)
new=$(readlink -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/system)
test "$new" != "$before"
test "$(readlink -f /run/current-system)" = "$new"
test "$(readlink /nix/var/nix/profiles/system)" != "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-link-before)"
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
grep -F "init=$new/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$default"
test "$(cat /etc/e2e-update)" = second-generation
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-boot)"
test "$(stat -c %U /etc/nixos/flake.nix)" = "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-user)"
if [ -s /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean ]; then
btrfs subvolume show /.snapshots/@root/CLEAN | grep -E 'UUID:|Creation time:' | cmp - /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean
else
test ! -e /.snapshots/@root/CLEAN
fi
test -e "$before"
test "$(nix-env --profile /nix/var/nix/profiles/system --list-generations | wc -l)" = 2
test "$(cat /root/.cache/nix/e2e-update-marker)" = kept
test ! -e "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-garbage)"
printf %s "$new" > /var/tmp/e2e-update-system-after
echo ephemeral > /root/e2e-update-ephemeral
sync
printf new-generation-running

set -ex
new=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-system-after)
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" != "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-update-boot)"
test "$(readlink -f /run/booted-system)" = "$new"
test "$(readlink -f /run/current-system)" = "$new"
grep -F "init=$new/init" /proc/cmdline
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
selected=$(tr -cd 'a-z0-9.-' < /sys/firmware/efi/efivars/LoaderEntrySelected-4a67b082-0a4c-41cf-b6c7-440b29bb8c4f)
test "$selected" = "$default"
grep -F "init=$new/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$selected"
test "$(cat /etc/e2e-update)" = second-generation
printf update-survived-reboot

set -ex
test ! -e /root/e2e-update-ephemeral
test "$(cat /.snapshots/@root/generation-1/root/e2e-update-ephemeral)" = ephemeral
journalctl -b -q --no-pager -o cat | grep -F 'Immutability complete'
if [ -s /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean ]; then
btrfs subvolume show /.snapshots/@root/CLEAN | grep -E 'UUID:|Creation time:' | cmp - /var/tmp/e2e-update-clean
else
test ! -e /.snapshots/@root/CLEAN
fi
printf reset-ran-after-update
